name: drupal/sentinel_connector
description: Drupal 10/11/12 module that reports installed extensions to the Sentinel monitoring platform.

suggest.drupal/config_pr: Required by the sentinel_connector_config_pr submodule, which opens configuration pull requests (^3.0).
suggest.drupal/key: Lets the sentinel_connector_config_pr submodule read its Git host token from a Key.
suggest.m4tthumphrey/php-gitlab-api: Required with config_pr_gitlab for GitLab merge requests (^12.0, with http-interop/http-factory-guzzle).
